entry.content: particle_podcast_find_mentions: description +**How each line is said.** Lines in topic and interview segments end with their speaker statement characteristics, pole labels only, e.g. `_[confident · positive · future]_`: sentiment (negative/positive), certainty (hedged/confident), specificity (vague/specific) and temporal orientation (past/future). A pole label means the line clearly reads that way; `_[neutral]_` means it leans clearly on no axis; no brackets means the line was not read (short lines, intros, ad breaks). With `output_format=json` they are each line's `speaker_statement_characteristics` object, middle labels included. particle_podcast_search_transcripts: description +**How each line is said.** Lines in topic and interview segments end with their speaker statement characteristics, pole labels only, e.g. `_[confident · positive · future]_`: sentiment (negative/positive), certainty (hedged/confident), specificity (vague/specific) and temporal orientation (past/future). A pole label means the line clearly reads that way; `_[neutral]_` means it leans clearly on no axis; no brackets means the line was not read (short lines, intros, ad breaks). With `output_format=json` they are each line's `speaker_statement_characteristics` object, middle labels included.
